title: tadu changes: what changed across the backlog in a range of days
notes: For a retro: who closed what, what got reopened, started or blocked. CLI, MCP and board; the last 14 days by default.
result: tadu changes (grouped text or JSON, --since/--until, --event, --author, --field), the MCP changes tool and the board's Changes view from /api/changes, for both formats and ranges across a migration
evidence: pytest: 1331 tests at 100% coverage, among them tests/test_repository_changes.py, test_run_changes.py, test_board_changes*.py and test_board_changes_js.py (the board filters, groups and describes changes as the command does); a jsdom run of the whole board against a live server; 14 days on 2,000 tasks in 0.4 s
